create_stepdata_instance: create a StepData NamedTuple with a dm_env timestep, action, and optional custom_data
create_stepdata_with_custom: create a StepData instance that includes custom_data alongside timestep and action fields
review_stepdata_fields: review the StepData NamedTuple attributes timestep, action, and custom_data for logging payloads
summarize_stepdata_class: summarize the StepData class used as a payload written at every dm_env.Environment step call
build_stepdata_logger: build a logging module that writes StepData instances to disk at each environment step
